requested_by_id.description: The ID of the member that requested the story.

iteration_id.description: The ID of the iteration the story belongs to.

custom_fields_remove.description: A map specifying a CustomField ID. These will be removed from any fields provided by the template. Cannot be used in conjunction with `custom_fields`.

tasks.description: An array of tasks connected to the story.
